paragraph: The Granville composite opens at a defensive 44/100, issuing a cautious primary verdict as core risk leadership breaks down despite the absence of a broad divergence warning. Tactical vulnerability is clearly visible in the system’s high-beta metrics, marked by semiconductor relative weakness (SOXX/SPY down -0.53%) and risk appetite deteriorating via the SPHB/SPLV ratio dropping -0.90%, even as equal-weight breadth sits marginally positive (RSP/SPY up +0.09%). Macro indicators provide an underlying volatility floor against immediate systemic selling, evidenced by a subdued spot VIX of 15.32 within a steep contango structure (10.7 front to 17.9 back) and tight high-yield credit spreads at 3.11%. However, persistent small-cap relative weakness at 0.3559 and a back-loaded volatility skew of -4.6 points confirm that capital is unwilling to chase upside in extended risk assets. Lean slightly bearish for today’s session, favoring defensive positioning and treating intraday pops in high-beta tech as opportunities to trim risk.
